premises.text: Online fashion lacks personalization—shoppers cannot know fit on standard models, so most fashion stays in-store
premises.evidence_span: What's missing in online fashion shopping is personalization. People still don't know how clothes fit when they're buying online

premises.text: Create a personal 3D model from two brand/size questions and true-to-size try-on/styling in a browser fitting room
premises.evidence_span: Creating a model is as simple as answering just two basic questions

premises.text: No special hardware/downloads; delivered in browser on PC, Mac, or iPad
premises.evidence_span: No need for special hardware or downloadable software, no creepy webcams or scanners. It's all delivered in browser

premises.text: Digitize designer collections at scale and offer retailers via API with pay-as-you-go, higher sales, fewer returns, and size/style analytics
premises.evidence_span: We work with fashion designers and digitize their collection

premises.text: Digitized fashion platform path toward mass customization to move remaining offline fashion online
premises.evidence_span: This is the path to mass customization, which is the Holy Grail of fashion

value.text: Shoppers pick styles and sizes that fit perfectly online; retailers get sales, fewer returns, and analytics
value.evidence_span: It looks great. It fits perfect

secondary_value.text: Retailers get increased sales, reduced returns, and consumer size/style analytics
secondary_value.evidence_span: They get increased sales, reduced returns, and they get access to this amazing data

causal_links.evidence_span: Because 90% of fashion is still sold in store
the retailers have no upfront costs. They pay us as they go
this is how we're going to get the remaining 90% of fashion market online

notes: Fit/personalization gap as problem. Model creation, drag-drop 3D try-on, size compare, outfit styling, Facebook share folded as fitting-room cascade (§4.1.7). Browser delivery as delivery surface of that product. Designer digitize+retailer API/analytics as B2B module. Mass-customization platform claim as separately asserted path to market. Partner traction logos excluded as metrics. Four domains.
